speaker: Microsoft Hazel Desktop
text: Good morning everyone. Let's start with the roadmap for the next quarter. We need to decide whether the search feature ships in October or slips to November.

speaker: Microsoft David Desktop
text: I think October is realistic if we cut the export options. The backend work is mostly done, and the remaining effort is on the user interface and testing.

speaker: Microsoft George
text: I disagree a little. The testing backlog is bigger than it looks. We still have around forty open bugs, and three of them block the release.

speaker: Microsoft Hazel Desktop
text: That is fair. Can we agree to review the bug list on Friday, and then make a final call? I will send out the calendar invite this afternoon.

speaker: Microsoft David Desktop
text: Sounds good to me. I will also prepare a short summary of the performance numbers, so we can see where the slowest queries are.

speaker: Microsoft George
text: Great. One more thing, the customer in Manchester asked for a demo next week. Should I schedule it, or wait until the bugs are fixed?

speaker: Microsoft Hazel Desktop
text: Schedule it for Thursday, but keep the demo focused on the dashboard only. We can show the search feature once it is stable.

speaker: Microsoft David Desktop
text: Agreed. I will update the documentation tonight, and share the link in the team channel tomorrow morning.

speaker: Microsoft George
text: Perfect. Then I think we are done. Thanks everyone, talk on Friday.

speaker: Microsoft Hazel Desktop
text: Thanks all. Have a good week.
